findings.issue: First-publication recovery can remove its pending marker before the private consumption record is durable.
findings.disposition: Recovery re-syncs the exact consumed receipt before finalizing the public artifact set.

findings.issue: Two interrupted first publications can prevent one another from reaching recovery.
findings.disposition: Recover each exact owned journal before requiring complete workspace discovery for another write.

findings.issue: Idle shutdown can strand an advancing Codex child search before source-proven descendants are discovered.
findings.disposition: An advancing bounded search continues across the idle boundary and worker lifetimes.

findings.issue: A consumed receipt can divert a moved ledger or reject an interrupted ordinary refresh at its original home.
findings.disposition: Current canonical resolution takes precedence, and exact owned v2 recovery validates the saved prior ledger.

findings.issue: A receipt retired after observing a portable ledger can strand an interrupted ordinary refresh.
findings.disposition: A closed receipt permits same-inode v2 recovery with an exact valid prior ledger and no fresh first-write authority.

findings.issue: Repeated terminal scans for the same unresolved hints can cause unbounded worker handoffs.
findings.disposition: Completed sweeps stay closed until fresh native evidence or explicit reconciliation warrants a new pass.

findings.issue: The gate can accept a rendered active-duration total that disagrees with native and ledger totals.
findings.disposition: Compare the rendered duration, ledger rollup and independent native measurements.

findings.issue: The native gate can credit later artifacts to a prior publication or miss the actual first completion-aware commit.
findings.disposition: Retain ordered fixture-local diagnostic copies and verify the artifact pair against the earliest eligible commit.

findings.issue: The held ledger snapshot can misclassify completed child time as provisional.
findings.disposition: Check held duration per owner against native completion and active interval evidence at the cutoff.

findings.issue: A missing OpenCode task tool can let the pinned gate pass without its supported grandchild.
findings.disposition: Require exact nested native and ledger parentage for both pinned clients.

findings.issue: The native oracle can overlook duplicate ledger tool rows and a fabricated cache-write field.
findings.disposition: Reject duplicate tool rows and unsupported persisted cache-write fields, and record what the native fixture exposes.

findings.issue: The focused SQLite test does not force a full worker retry after registry contention.
findings.disposition: The test exercises real typed lock classification and review traces the bounded retry. The native timing sample with contention predates the retry change.
